lesson: Today we work on one technique. It is letting one ordinary thing hold the emotion, so you describe the object and the reader feels the person through it. This poem does that with the boots. Look at have kept the shape of your feet. That is the boots, but you feel the person who wore them. Then one lace still holding a knot, you tied in the dark. Again, the boots, but you feel a tired person who worked late. Then the whole weeks walking gone quiet in the leather. Same trick. It works because you never get told the person is tired. You get told about the boots. Your mind does the rest, so the feeling arrives without anyone naming it. That makes it stick. Try this, pick one object the person touched and describe only the object, not the feeling. The second time, track the boots and where they hand off to the papers in the hills.
